reviews.review_description: I felt I had to take a little gamble with using MyLite as I had no experience with the company and reviews were difficult to find. However a friend knew the sales rep Jason personally and spoke of him as a good guy. Our experience with Jason and the MyLite team certainly reflects that.MyLite spent the time to get to know what are requirements and concerns were. They provided an excellent quality product which is ethically produced compared to some items on the market.Installation happened on time, quickly and efficiently with a friendly bunch of installers lead by Colin.  All rubbish was taken away after wards.Jason and Mark from MyLite have been in contact several times since to check all is working well, including a site visit to set up the Wifi App to allow us to track solar production.  No hesitation in using this company and recommending to others.
